title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E16 — The Big Party
Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E5 — Not My Pumpkin
Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E6 — Just Above My Head
Moesha finds her history teacher’s remarks racially offensive, but fears that confronting him might affect her grade and cost Niecy her scholarship.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E7 — A Den Is A Terrible Thing To Waste
A well-intentioned Moesha intervenes to try and stop her once-popular hangout, The Den, from being sold to a commercial developer, unaware that Andell stands to make a great deal of money on its sale.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E8 — Isn’t She Lovely?
Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E9 — Unappreciated Interest
Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E11 — Christmas '95
A trip to a nostalgic tree farm is ruined for Mark and his friends until they all learn the true meaning of Christmas.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E12 — Increase the Peace
Earvin is challenged by a gang member, and Mark intervenes. Raven appears in this episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E13 — Robo Golf
Mark makes a risky investment. MARK LINN-BAKER guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E14 — Coach Counselor
Mark loses his office and Geneva promises him another--for a price.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E15 — Talent Show
Mark's a hero when he gets a famous musical group to promise to perform at the school carnival--until they fail to show up. TYRESE guest stars as Darrell.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E16 — Globetrotters
THE HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS (themselves) are playing in town, but Mark might have to miss them.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E17 — Rivals
Mark's competition with a rival coach escalates to a life-threatening degree. JAMIE FOXX guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E18 — The Curse
Mark doesn't believe the great car he just bought is haunted--until bad luck starts happening to him and everyone around him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E19 — Grumpy Old Man
Mark plays matchmaker to an elderly couple so he can buy a classic car. Geneva worries that no one on the faculty likes her.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E20 — True Confessions
When Vanessa dates a successful, handsome man (WILLIE GAULT), Mark has an unexpected reaction.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E18 — Borrowed Time
Rob's dad kidnaps him and Webster tries to rally up support to try and find him.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E20 — A Friend in Need
Jerry dresses up like a clown and takes Webster to the leukemia ward at the children's hospital, where he makes a new friend and realizes how lucky he is to be healthy.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E21 — Almost Home
Webster's Uncle Jack has Webster visit him. Uncle Jack runs a foster home with a woman, but a conflict may force him to quit the home.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E22 — Farewell to Arms
Webster asks permission to buy a BB gun and he resorts to responsibility to get one. After getting one, and practicing with his friends, he accidentally kills a bird. This bird has babies and he takes the responsibility of raising them on his own.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E27 — My Family's Honor
Webster and Katherine both end up cheating on some school-related projects at the same time.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E10 — Thanksgiving
With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.
